The university received so many applications that it had to hire extra staff, and so [ ____ ] the neighboring college.
Little [ ____ ] that the minor flaw they had ignored during testing, dismissing it as a harmless glitch, would eventually bring down the entire system.
Not until the secret files were opened decades later [ ____ ] how many civilians had been secretly relocated.

Seldom [ ____ ] admit publicly that their forecasts were wrong.

the economists who advise the government

grammar.q: Only by comparing thousands of genetic samples [ ____ ] identify the mutations that amplify the risk of disease.
Under the layers of volcanic ash that buried the ancient city [ ____ ] found the remains of houses, shops, and even loaves of bread, preserved almost perfectly by the absence of oxygen.
Along the northern edge of the park, where few tourists ever venture, [ ____ ] a fortress built eight centuries ago to guard the kingdom’s border against invasion.
So severe [ ____ ] caused by the earthquake, which struck shortly before dawn, that engineers recommended demolishing most of the old district rather than attempting costly repairs.
The journalist asked the minister why [ ____ ] the warnings issued by its own scientists.
Do you happen to know how long [ ____ ] for the damaged forests along the coast to recover from last summer’s wildfire, which burned nearly half of them?
Where do you think [ ____ ] next year’s conference, considering that many participants will travel from Asia?
The first survey revealed no shift in attitudes toward immigration, and [ ____ ] the second.
Living far from the capital, most voters had never heard of the candidate before the debate, and [ ____ ] .
Not until the patient, who had been misdiagnosed twice, described her symptoms in detail [ ____ ] that her illness was a rare adverse reaction to her medication.
The two nations signed [ ____ ] agreement on trade that experts expected it to fundamentally reshape the regional economy.
The evidence collected by the investigators was not [ ____ ] to prove that the factory had secretly dumped sewage into the river.
There [ ____ ] a growing body of research suggesting that children who spend more time outdoors are less likely to become nearsighted.
Down from the glaciers at the top of the valley [ ____ ] the icy water that supplies millions of people in the cities below, although the glaciers themselves are shrinking at an alarming rate.

grammar.q: Hidden in the margins of the memoir [ ____ ] notes in a code that scholars have never deciphered.

arrange.ko: 과학자들은 마을 우물의 물을 검사하고 나서야 비로소 아이들 사이에 퍼진 그 병의 진짜 원인을 발견했다.
arrange.bogi: did they / not until / discovered / the scientists tested the water from the village wells / the real cause of the disease that had spread among the children
arrange.ans: Not until the scientists tested the water from the village wells did they discover the real cause of the disease that had spread among the children.

arrange.ko: 너는 국립 박물관의 새 전시관에 전시된 고대 유물들이 원래 정확히 어느 나라에서 왔는지 아니?
arrange.bogi: originally came from / do you know / the ancient objects displayed in the national museum’s new gallery / exactly which country
arrange.ans: Do you know exactly which country the ancient objects displayed in the national museum’s new gallery originally came from?

arrange.ko: 그 계곡의 맨 끝에는 수백 년 동안 침입자들로부터 그 지역을 지켜 온 한 성의 무너진 성벽들이 서 있다. (장소 부사구로 시작하는 도치 문장)
arrange.bogi: stands / at the far end of the valley / that protected the region from invaders for centuries / the ruined walls of a castle
arrange.ans: At the far end of the valley stand the ruined walls of a castle that protected the region from invaders for centuries.

arrange.ko: 그 영화가 개봉되자마자 비평가들은 그것을 올해 최고의 작품이라고 부르기 시작했다. (No sooner로 시작하는 문장)
arrange.bogi: than critics began calling it / no sooner / be released / had the film / the finest work of the year
arrange.ans: No sooner had the film been released than critics began calling it the finest work of the year.

arrange.ko: 학생들이 사실 뒤의 증거와 그것을 모은 사람들에게 의문을 품지 않고 교과서 속 사실들을 외우는 것만으로는 충분하지 않다.
arrange.bogi: to memorize the facts in their textbooks without questioning / enough for students / it is not / the evidence behind them and the people who collected it
arrange.ans: It is not enough for students to memorize the facts in their textbooks without questioning the evidence behind them and the people who collected it.

arrange.ko: 과학자들은 수면 부족이 학습 직후 몇 시간 동안 뇌가 새 정보를 저장하는 방식에 어떻게 영향을 주는지 아직 완전히 이해하지 못한다.
arrange.bogi: affect / scientists / the way the brain stores new information in the hours after learning / do not yet fully understand / how a lack of sleep
arrange.ans: Scientists do not yet fully understand how a lack of sleep affects the way the brain stores new information in the hours after learning.

arrange.ko: 비용을 감당할 만큼 승객을 끌지 못할 수도 있는 실험적인 교통 체계에 수백만 달러를 쓸 여유가 있는 것은 큰 도시들뿐이다.
arrange.bogi: spend millions of dollars on experimental transport systems / only large cities / that may fail to attract enough passengers to cover their costs / can afford
arrange.ans: Only large cities can afford to spend millions of dollars on experimental transport systems that may fail to attract enough passengers to cover their costs.

arrange.ko: 많은 회사들은 이제 직원 교육을 불필요한 비용이 아니라 자신의 미래 성장을 위한 투자로 본다.
arrange.bogi: not as an unnecessary cost / many companies now see / but as an investment in their own future growth / the training of their employees
arrange.ans: Many companies now see the training of their employees not as an unnecessary cost but as an investment in their own future growth.

arrange.ko: 체육 교사들은 운동 자체에 기울이는 만큼 그 운동을 하는 학생들에게 주의를 기울이는 경우가 거의 없다.
arrange.bogi: as they do to the exercises themselves / rarely / paid as much attention to the students who perform the exercises / do physical education teachers
arrange.ans: Rarely do physical education teachers pay as much attention to the students who perform the exercises as they do to the exercises themselves.

arrange.ko: 년에 한 동물학자가 동물의 의식에 관한 책을 펴내고 나서야 비로소 많은 과학자들이 동물의 마음을 진지하게 받아들이기 시작했다.
arrange.bogi: did many scientists / a zoologist published a book on animal awareness in 1976 / began to take the minds of animals seriously / not until
arrange.ans: Not until a zoologist published a book on animal awareness in 1976 did many scientists begin to take the minds of animals seriously.

arrange.ko: 작은 동물들의 에너지 비축량은 너무 적어서 그들은 먹이를 찾거나 적으로부터 자신을 지킬 때 선택의 여지가 거의 없다. (So로 시작하는 도치 문장)
arrange.bogi: is / that they have few choices when searching for food or defending themselves against enemies / so limited / the energy reserves of small animals
arrange.ans: So limited are the energy reserves of small animals that they have few choices when searching for food or defending themselves against enemies.

arrange.ko: 새 지하철 노선이 개통되자마자 역 근처 아파트 가격이 급격히 오르기 시작해, 오래 살던 많은 주민들을 그 지역 밖으로 밀어냈다.
arrange.bogi: begin to rise sharply, / had the new subway line opened / pushing many longtime residents out of the area / no sooner / than the prices of apartments near its stations
arrange.ans: No sooner had the new subway line opened than the prices of apartments near its stations began to rise sharply, pushing many longtime residents out of the area.

translate.en: They had flexible behavior, he said, or the ability to change their behavior as external circumstances changed, a hallmark of true intelligence.
translate.ko: 그것들은 유연한 행동, 즉 외부 환경이 변함에 따라 자신의 행동을 바꾸는 능력을 가졌는데, 이는 진정한 지능의 특징이라고 그는 말했다.

translate.en: Instructors must raise participants’ awareness of how these activities enhance their physical performance.
translate.ko: 지도자들은 이러한 활동이 그들의 신체적 수행을 어떻게 향상시키는지에 대한 참여자들의 인식을 높여야 한다.

translate.en: In fact, scientists attributing consciousness to any animal is so recent that the internet is older.
translate.ko: 사실 과학자들이 어떤 동물에게든 의식이 있다고 여기는 일은 너무 최근이어서 인터넷이 더 오래되었다.

translate.en: Large animals can afford to vary their mating and food-searching behaviors in an effort to better optimize their behaviors.
translate.ko: 몸집이 큰 동물은 자신의 행동을 더 잘 최적화하기 위한 노력의 일환으로 짝짓기와 먹이 찾기 행동을 바꿀 여유가 있다.

translate.en: Transport operators, particularly in the airline business, saw the sale of transport services as being integral to a much wider need.
translate.ko: 운송업체, 특히 항공업계의 운송업체는 운송 서비스의 판매를 훨씬 더 폭넓은 필요와 불가분의 관계에 있는 것으로 보았다.

translate.en: Car manufacturers know people form emotional attachments to automobile ‘faces’ and use the fact to guide their design and marketing efforts.
translate.ko: 자동차 제조사들은 사람들이 자동차의 ‘얼굴’에 정서적 애착을 형성한다는 것을 알고 있으며, 그 사실을 디자인과 마케팅 노력을 이끄는 데 사용한다.

translate.en: “In today’s hyper-competitive car market, designers are focusing on faces as part of a broader effort to design cars that appeal to buyers ― tapping psychologists, anthropologists and other experts in human behavior, and even monitoring the brain waves of focus-group participants,” the Wall Street Journal reported in a 2006 article entitled ‘Why Cars Got Angry.’
translate.ko: ‘Wall Street Journal’은 2006년 ‘왜 자동차는 화가 났는가’라는 제목의 기사에서 “오늘날의 과도하게 경쟁적인 자동차 시장에서 디자이너들은 구매자의 마음을 끄는 자동차를 디자인하려는 더 폭넓은 노력의 일환으로 얼굴에 집중하고 있으며, 심리학자, 인류학자 및 기타 인간 행동 전문가들을 활용하고 심지어 포커스 그룹 참가자들의 뇌파까지 관찰하고 있다”고 보도했다.

translate.en: Automotive research shows “70% of drivers identify and judge vehicles by the headlights and grille,” the article reported.
translate.ko: 그 기사는 자동차 연구가 “운전자의 70%가 헤드라이트와 그릴로 차량을 식별하고 평가한다”는 것을 보여 준다고 전했다.

translate.en: In the first years of the twenty-first century, the trend was toward angrier, scarier vehicles’ faces.
translate.ko: 21세기 초반에는 추세가 더 화나고 더 무서운 차량의 얼굴 쪽으로 향했다.

translate.en: The article hypothesized that these faces help drivers feel safer in heavier traffic amidst more oversize SUVs.
translate.ko: 그 기사는 이러한 얼굴이 더 많은 대형 SUV들 사이, 더 혼잡한 교통 속에서 운전자가 더 안전하다고 느끼도록 돕는다고 가정했다.

translate.en: Reflecting our tumultuous times, the ‘scary look’ shows no sign of slowing in the new millennium.
translate.ko: 우리의 떠들썩한 시대를 반영하여, ‘무서운 외관’은 새 천년에도 수그러들 기미를 보이지 않는다.

translate.en: “Buoyant sales of cars with styling which suggests power or bad temper seem to confirm that customers are happy with this look,” an international automotive site reported in 2017.
translate.ko: 2017년에 한 국제 자동차 사이트는 “힘이나 거친 기질을 연상시키는 스타일의 자동차가 활발하게 팔리는 것은 소비자들이 이 외관에 만족한다는 것을 확인해 주는 듯하다”고 보도했다.
